system.description: This polished sphere is a green-and-violet opal flecked with gold. It gives a +2 bonus to Wits or Perception rolls to detect ambushes. If the bearer is ever successfully ambushed, the stone also increases her DV by 1 against unexpected attacks; this bonus affects the final value, not the pool used to calculate it. Finally, the stone gives three dice to all rolls to evade tracking and pursuit.
